description: Windows launcher for Commander X16 programs. Browse X16 Files and the SD Card Kit, import local PRG, BAS and ZIP files, or launch Favorites with saved emulator settings. The History tab shows past launch commands and lets you run them again with the same emulator, CPU, clock speed and RAM. Requires Windows 10 or later and .NET Framework 4.8 or later. The project welcomes feedback on finding and installing programs through the X16 Files catalog.
name: X16 For All Time
